release.title: Results release
release.description: Every publish creates a new, permanently recorded version with a SHA-256 fingerprint chained to the previous one. Certifying a version makes it official and locks all timing, penalties, and result-affecting participant details until the results are reopened with a reason.
release.none: Results have not been published yet.
release.intact: Published results match their recorded fingerprint.
release.notIntact: The published results no longer match their recorded fingerprint. Someone changed them outside the platform. Do not certify; investigate and republish.
release.chainBroken: The version history has been altered outside the platform.
release.changed: Timing or results changed after this version was published. Publish again before certifying.
release.certifyConfirm: Certify version {{version}} as the official results? Timing and result details will be locked.
release.certifyFailed: The results could not be certified.
release.reopenReason: Reason for reopening (for example, an upheld protest)
release.reopened: Results reopened. Make the changes, then publish and certify again.
release.reopenFailed: The results could not be reopened.
release.reopenReasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 5 characters.

anomalies.title: Timing review
anomalies.description: Times officials should check before certifying. Nothing here changes a result; resolve each one by correcting the time with a reason, applying a penalty or decision, or accepting it.
anomalies.loadFailed: Timing review could not be loaded.

types.MISSING_SPLIT: Finished without a time at this timed mat (possible course cut or missed read)
types.IMPLAUSIBLE_SPLIT: Segment run at {{speed}} km/h (possible swapped chip or wrong-side read)
types.OUT_OF_ORDER: Recorded here before the previous mat

queries.askTitle: Ask officials to review your time
queries.askDescription: Explain what looks wrong, for example a missing split or a time that does not match your watch. Officials reply before the results are made official.
queries.sent: Your query was sent to the race officials.
queries.sendFailed: The query could not be sent.
queries.tooShort: Describe the problem in at least 10 characters.
queries.limit: You already have open queries for this race. Officials will answer them first.
queries.locked: Results for this race are already official.
queries.panelDescription: Answer every query before certifying the results. The athlete is notified of your answer.
queries.note: Answer (sent to the athlete and recorded in the audit log)
queries.answerFailed: The answer could not be saved.
queries.noteRequired: Write an answer of at least 5 characters.

ui.resultsChangedReloadingFromTheFirst: Results changed. Reloading from the first page.
